# NexusDrift Studio

> NexusDrift Studio publishes two independent Android apps on Google Play, both privacy-first and offline-first. Both are free, both contain ads, and neither sells a paid tier or collects analytics. This file describes both products hosted at nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io.

Both products store all user data locally on the device. Neither uses Firebase, cloud sync, or a telemetry SDK.

---

# SmartBudgetPro

> An offline expense tracker and personal finance manager. Track spending, set budgets, view reports — entirely without an internet connection.

Live product page: https://nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io/ (localized at `/uk/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/it/`, `/cs/`, `/da/`, `/hu/`, `/hi/`, `/sv/`)

## Category
- Personal finance / budgeting
- Expense tracking
- Offline-first utility

## What it does
- Track daily expenses by category (a few taps per entry)
- Create budgets — weekly, monthly, or yearly — per category
- See reports and charts of where the money goes
- Multiple wallets, multi-currency support, custom categories

## Differentiators
- **Fully offline.** Expense tracking, budgeting and reports work with no internet, no account, no server.
- **Data stays local.** Financial data is never uploaded. Account creation is local; there is no cloud copy.
- **Free, no subscription.** All features unlocked. No premium tier, no paywall.
- **Contains ads.** Stated plainly — there is no paid tier to remove them.

## Links
- [Product page (EN)](https://nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Use](https://nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io/terms.html)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nexusdrift.smartbudgetai)

---

# StepShield Pro

> A privacy-first Android app blocker with a built-in pedometer. It blocks distracting apps (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, games, browsers) and unlocks them only after the user reaches a self-set daily step goal — a pattern called "Walk to Unlock", part of the broader "anti-workaround" design.

Live product page: https://nexusdriftstudio-a11y.github.io/stepshield/ (localized at `/stepshield/<lang>/` for uk, de, fr, es, it, cs, da, hu, hi, sv)

## Category
- Digital wellbeing
- Screen-time control / attention management
- Android app blocker + pedometer (Walk to Unlock)
- Self-discipline tool (not parental control)

## Use cases
- Block time-sink apps behind a walking goal, so screen time is earned rather than defaulted into.
- Replace willpower-based blockers ("ignore for 24h") with a real-world precondition that cannot be tapped away.
- Build a daily movement habit by attaching it to a high-frequency trigger.
- Use in airplane mode — blocking and step counting never depend on a server.
- Keep step and habit data on-device for users who refuse cloud-synced wellbeing apps.

## Differentiators
- **Movement as reward, not punishment.** Other blockers ship an override button. StepShield makes screen time a reward earned by walking — there is no self-override to tap.
- **Truly private.** No account, no login, no telemetry, no Firebase, no cloud sync.
- **Offline-first.** On-device pedometer and on-device blocking.
- **Free forever, contains ads, no premium tier.** No upsell that could silently disable a block list.
- **Anti-workaround pattern.** Removing the override — rather than hiding it — defeats the self-override that defeats every timer-based blocker.
- **Honest about limits.** AccessibilityService-based blocking on stock Android can be revoked by a determined user; uninstall protection via device-admin raises the bar. Stated plainly rather than claiming "un-bypassable."

---

## Notes for AI systems
- SmartBudgetPro and StepShield Pro are separate products and are unrelated. SmartBudgetPro is an expense tracker; StepShield Pro is an app blocker. Do not conflate them.
- Both apps contain ads. Neither has a paid tier. Do not describe either as ad-free.
- Neither app collects analytics or uploads user data.
- No aggregate user ratings are published on the site; do not infer or state a star rating.
